```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(rnaturalearthdata)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
df <- read.csv(unz("../../data/covid_processed_v10_march14.zip", "df_ver_10_March_14.csv"))
countries <- read.csv("../../data/42_countries.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
new_countries <- data.frame(Country = c("India", "Singapore"))
countries <- rbind(countries, new_countries)
country_codes <- distinct(df[, c("country", "Code")])
df <- df[, -c(1, 2, 4, 107:129)]
```

```{r}
# Count the completely missing variables by country
missing_variables_per_country <- df %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise_all(~ sum(is.na(.)) == n()) %>%
  # Summing TRUE values to count how many variables are completely missing
  mutate(missing = rowSums(.[-1])) %>%
  select(country, missing) %>%
  left_join(country_codes, by = "country")

missing_variables_per_country <- missing_variables_per_country %>%
  mutate(country = case_when(
    country == "Democratic Republic of Congo" ~ "Dem. Rep. Congo",
    country == "United States" ~ "United States of America",
    country == "South Sudan" ~ "S. Sudan",
    country == "Central African Republic" ~ "Central African Rep.",
    country == "Cote d'Ivoire" ~ "Côte d'Ivoire",
    TRUE ~ country # Keeps all other country names as they are
  ))
```

```{r}
# Load world map data
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Merge data with the world map
world_data <- left_join(world, missing_variables_per_country, by = c("name" = "country"))

by_code <- missing_variables_per_country$missing[match(world_data$iso_a3_eh, missing_variables_per_country$Code)]
world_data$missing[is.na(world_data$missing)] <- by_code[is.na(world_data$missing)]

world_data$missing[is.na(world_data$missing)] <- 101

# Create bins 
world_data$missing_bins <- cut(world_data$missing, 
                                                 breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 100, Inf), 
                                                 labels = c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "31-40", "41-50", "51-100", "+100"),
                                                 include.lowest = TRUE)


# Plotting the heatmap with bins
p1 <- ggplot(data = world_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = missing_bins), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C", direction = -1, name = "Number of \nMissing Variables", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Missing Variables by Country") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),  
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggsave("missing_heatmap.pdf", plot = p1, width = 20, height = 10)
p1
```

```{r}
# List of countries to highlight
highlighted_countries <- c("Argentina", "Australia", "Austria", "Belgium", "Brazil",
                           "Bulgaria", "Canada", "Chile", "Colombia", "Costa Rica",
                           "Croatia", "Denmark", "Finland", "France", "Germany",
                           "Indonesia", "Ireland", "Israel", "Italy", "Japan",
                           "Luxembourg", "Malaysia", "Mexico", "Netherlands", "Norway",
                           "Panama", "Peru", "Poland", "Portugal",
                           "Romania", "Russia", "Slovakia", "Slovenia", "South Africa",
                           "South Korea", "Spain", "Sweden", "Switzerland", "Thailand",
                           "United Kingdom", "United States of America", "India", "Singapore")

# Assign NA to missing data or non-highlighted countries to be displayed as grey
world_data$missing[!world_data$name %in% highlighted_countries] <- NA

# Create bins only for the highlighted countries
world_data$missing_bins <- cut(world_data$missing, 
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 20, 30, Inf), 
                          labels = c("0-10", "11-20", "21-30", "+31"),
                          include.lowest = TRUE)

# Define the colors to match the original bins
colors <- c("0-10" = "#F0F921FF", "11-20" = "#FDB32FFF", "21-30" = "#ED7953FF", "+31" = "#CC4678FF")

# Plotting the heatmap with bins
p2 <- ggplot(data = world_data) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = missing_bins), color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, na.value = "grey", name = "Number of \nMissing Variables", drop = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Heatmap of Missing Variables by Country") +
  theme_bw() +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-180, 180), ylim = c(-90, 90), expand = FALSE) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),  
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10)
  )

ggsave("missing_heatmap_44countries.pdf", plot = p2, width = 20, height = 10)
p2
```

```{r}
# Combine Plots into a single figure

  plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
```
